AGENDA
  HOUSING AUTHORITY
  SEPTEMBER 19, 2023

  REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA TELECONFERENCE
  5:45 PM

UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF ASSEMBLY
BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS COUNCIL MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A REMOTE LOCATION WITHOUT
LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING: YOU MAY ATTEND THE
MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, OR JOIN THE ZOOM MEETING BY
CALLING: (669) 900-6833 OR USING THE ZOOM APP WITH THE FOLLOWING LINK:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/7095732685; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED
THROUGH ZOOM, FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3, OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.

  Ana Valencia, Chair
  Margarita L. Rios, Vice Chair
  Tony Ayala, Commissioner
  Jennifer Perez, Commissioner
  Rick Ramirez, Commissioner
  La Tosha Davis, Commissioner
  Mary Hernandez, Commissioner

Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the Housing Authority on any matter listed on the agenda or on any other matter within
its jurisdiction subject to the rules of decorum described in Section 2.08.020 of the Norwalk Municipal Code. If you wish to address the Housing
Authority, please complete the card that is provided at the rear entrance to Council Chambers and hand the card to the Sergeant at Arms. The
Housing Authority will hear public comment on items listed on the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote. The Housing
Authority will hear public comment on matters not listed on the agenda during the Oral Communications period.

Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or
special circumstances exist. The Housing Authority may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for consideration at a future
Housing Authority meeting.

Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Housing Authority:
  � Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  � Comments should be directed to the Housing Authority as a whole and not directed to individual Commissioners.

Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services
offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City
Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist
the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Housing Authority regarding any item on this agenda after it has been posted
will also be made available for public inspection.

Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk’s Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard during regular business
hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday – Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday; telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also
contact the City Clerk via e-mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.
 CALL TO ORDER

Chair Valencia

ROLL CALL

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk

  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK HOUSING AUTHORITY
  NORWALK, CALIFORNIA
  AUGUST 15, 2023

Chair Valencia called the hybrid meeting to order at 6:02 p.m. in the Council Chambers,
Norwalk City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California and via
videoconference per Assembly Bill 361. Commissioners Perez and Ramirez, and Vice
Chair Rios, and Chair Valencia were present in person. Commissioners Davis and
Hernandez were present via videoconference. Commissioner Ayala was absent. Also
present were Jesus M. Gomez, Executive Director; John Lam, Deputy Authority
Counsel; John P. Ramirez, Director of Community Development; and Theresa Devoy,
Clerk.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one
motion and roll call vote. Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and
considered separately by the Housing Authority. Commissioner Ramirez moved and
Commissioner Perez seconded to approve the consent calendar as recommended.
MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Commissioners Davis*, Hernandez**, Perez, Ramirez, Vice Chair Rios,
  and Chair Valencia
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  Commissioner Ayala

MINUTES

The Housing Authority approved the minutes of the regular meeting of July 18, 2023, as
submitted.  315-05-03

WARRANTS

The Housing Authority approved the warrant run for the dates July 15, 2023 – August 1,
2023, for a grand total of $689,404.64.
*Commissioner Davis abstained from taking action on Warrant No. 223197.
**Commissioner Hernandez abstained from taking action on Warrant No. 68107.  315-03-02

COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR REPORT

None.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Norwalk Housing Authority
August 15, 2023

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

There were no persons wishing to address the Housing Authority.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business to come before the Housing Authority, the meeting was
adjourned at 6:05 p.m.

  THERESA DEVOY, CMC
  CLERK
